title: crepis tectorum subsp. nigrescens
intro: Crepis tectorum subsp. nigrescens, commonly known as Black Hawk's-bit, is a plant species within the family Asteraceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving digestion due to its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Crepis tectorum subsp. nigrescens are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antioxidant activity, which may help in preventing cell damage. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
